notes.title: Festive Update now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Color Connect 2021 Christmas update now available. Once you have earned 20+ stars on the main game you will unlock the Christmas environment and levels - accessed through the main menu level select screen by clicking on the gift box. It is our present to you this year.

12 new unique levels with varying difficulty. Help to build the festive world around you earning stars as you go. Some real surprises along the way add approximately 1hr of gameplay to the Color Connect main game. The best part... It's free!!!

We wish you all a very merry Christmas and a happy new year from all at Sandford Tech. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104317/a92185f9cfc1f751e38d4bd17fe43b13b973eb72.png[/img]

notes.title: 2 New exciting Features - Color Picker and Grabbing
notes.notes:
We have 2 new exciting features to make Color Connect more accessible for all of our users. Following feedback from many of our players, we are please to announce...

1. You can now personalize your playing experience by selecting your own colors to play with. Whether you're looking to mix things up with a fresh new look, or have experienced issues distinguishing between colors, you now have this option. Within the settings menu you can amend each color to suit and save for later. Alternatively you can choose between the preset color blind modes *Deuteranopia*, *Protanopia* and *Tritanopia*. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104317/d763fa71ede2aa1a8dcb73200e4108ddb83ec2e5.jpg[/img]

2. Grabbing - in addition to the joystick movement controls, you are now able to grab the puzzle and move it with one hand or have complete control over motion with both hands. All you need to do is squeeze the trigger clicking anywhere on the screen when not engaging with a node.

We hope you like the new features and if you have any suggestions of things you would like to see changed, please get in touch, we'd love to hear from you.

All the best - the color connect team (Sandford Tech)

notes.title: HTC Vive and Valve Index Devices are now supported

Support for HTC Vive and Valve Index devices has been added in the latest build of Color Connect.
